_provenance.method: live Playwright render, cross-referenced with captured CSS custom properties
_provenance.notes: Single-page extract (homepage). Palette resolved from --color-* design tokens captured at :root.

logo.source: inline SVG wordmark in header + apple-touch-icon

type.characteristics: Rounded, chunky, friendly geometric. Feather is a proprietary rounded display face; body is a DIN-round geometric sans. Headlines lowercase by convention.

motifs.signatureButton: 3D 'pushable' button: solid fill + a darker bottom border (box-shadow 0 N 0 shadow-color) that compresses on press. The single most recognizable Duolingo UI gesture.
motifs.illustration: Flat, rounded, brightly-colored character illustrations (Duo + cast). Generous negative space around each illustration cluster.

voice.heroHeadline: The free, fun, and effective way to learn a language!
voice.register: Playful, warm, encouraging, plain-spoken. Lowercase headlines. Short declaratives. Emoji-adjacent cheer without being childish.
voice.firstParagraph: Learning with Duolingo is fun, and research shows that it works! With quick, bite-sized lessons, you'll earn points and unlock new levels while gaining real-world communication skills.
voice.heroImage: Mascot/character illustration cluster (Duo the owl + cast), centered above the fold

systemComponents.header: Top nav: lowercase 'duolingo' wordmark left, SITE LANGUAGE selector + 'I ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT' right
systemComponents.footer: Full-bleed green (#58CC02) footer with white multi-column link lists (About, Products, Apps, Help, etc.) and social row
systemComponents.appStoreBadges: App Store + Google Play download badges
